units.source_text: 这次的笑，实际理由很简单，也许只不过是由于我鼓足劲说话，给巴更加厉害的缘故吧。

en.t: The real reason for this burst of laughter was very simple: perhaps it was only because I had worked myself up as I spoke, and had been even harsher toward Tomoe.

units.source_text: 总之，鞠子完全不相信我的话了。

en.t: In any case, Mariko no longer believed a word I said.
